Purpose: skill cover illustration, not a required style template for future games.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished landscape 16:9 cover illustration for a reusable AI skill that transforms a short idea into a highly interactive 3D exploration game. Original art direction: premium whimsical handcrafted 3D adventure diorama, tactile clay-like surfaces, richly detailed but clear silhouettes, warm cream and sage green contrasted with luminous lavender and sky blue. Composition: large elegant title space in the upper left on a clean pale cream sky; visually rich connected floating miniature worlds across the lower two-thirds and right. Foreground: an original small childlike fairy traveler wearing a cream hood, short coral cape and ochre backpack, seen in three-quarter back view stepping onto a giant springy leaf, charming readable hands. Three DIFFERENT worlds connected by a subtle trail of light: lush grassy valley with exactly one mushroom cottage whose open door contains a glowing portal revealing a moonlit lake; a taller sky ruin with leaning stone arch, floating grassy platforms and wind currents, NO houses; a low reflective moonlit wetland with giant blue mushrooms, luminous flowers and stepping stones, NO houses. A tiny cream and sage green brass-trimmed garden locomotive with open cabin travels on clearly continuous small curved double railway tracks in the foreground valley. Show playful action through a leaf flexing upward, a gentle double-jump sparkling arc, wind rings and an inviting door portal. Keep all elements coherent within one carefully art-directed scene, not separate panels, no UI screenshots, no technical diagrams, no skeleton overlay, no generic robots, no excessive buildings, no clutter. Soft cinematic sunlight with gentle violet glow, subtle ambient occlusion, editorial-quality composition, high visual fidelity, complete objects with comfortable margins. Text: only a large beautifully typeset Chinese title at upper left, exactly “一句话，造一个世界”. Beneath it a small restrained subtitle, exactly “可交互三维游戏生成”. No other text, no logos, no watermarks. This is the cover for a skill, so make it visually arresting at thumbnail size while keeping the title exceptionally legible.
